== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-01-Grievous_Hunter_Of_Jedi.png]]) and [[:File:VL-history-1271-1-front-original.png]] show the original text; the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1271-1-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-grievoushunterofjedi-pre.gif]]) show PC-E2 (renamed Grievous).

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, 2012-07-21 capture: https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013), title “Cyborg Commander, Hunter Of Jedi”. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “[Virtual Block 5 icon] Dark Jedi Lightsaber may deploy on Cyborg. Jedi present are power -1 (-2 if a Jedi Council Member). While armed with a lightsaber, your battle destiny draws are +1 here and Cyborg Commander's forfeit may not be reduced. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1271_1</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
